newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Medical unit, IVAC complete merger.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Medical unit, IVAC complete merger.

text.p: Advanced Medical Inc and IVAC Medical Systems Inc on Tuesday said they completed the $400 million merger of IVAC and Advanced Medical unit, IMED Corp, creating a worldwide seller of intravenous infusion therapy products.
Advanced Medical said it expects a charge against earnings in the fourth quarter of 1996 to complete the deal, but details of the charge were not disclosed.
"Our strategic intent is to become the global leader in advanced medical instruments and devices," William Mercer, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
On a combined basis, the company would have generated over $350 million in sales in 1995. The merger provides economies of scale and manufacturing synergies, the companies said.
Benefits also may include a broader product portfolio, expanded customer base, greater purchasing power, improved cross-selling and enhanceed financial strength.

The price was paid in cash and with related transactions, was financed through a $250 million bank credit line, $200 million of subordinated notes, and $77.5 million of common equity from Advanced Medical Chairman Jeffry Picower.
